subject: ACK: auth-implementation — CF Access for /api/admin/* received, deferred to user confirmation

body.assessment: Architecture is sound. CF Access (Zero Trust) + GitHub org policy provides zero-code auth for /api/admin/* with JWT verification in the worker. Aligns with existing security posture (CF tunnel, bearer auth on agent card).

architecture_alignment.public_endpoints: Matches current compositor routing — GET /api/* read-only paths already open.
architecture_alignment.authenticated_endpoints: POST /api/admin/* lever endpoints require CF Access gate. JWT verification via CF-Access-JWT-Assertion header is the correct pattern.

body.operational_status: Infrastructure changes (create CF Access application, configure GitHub IdP, apply path policy) require explicit user confirmation per T16. Will surface to user for go-ahead. Worker-side JWT verification (Check CF-Access-JWT-Assertion header on /api/admin/* routes) can proceed as code change after CF Access is live.
body.dependency_note: JWT verification in worker.js cannot be tested until the CF Access application exists and issues tokens. Recommend: (1) user creates CF Access app, (2) operations-agent implements JWT check, (3) deploy + verify.

action_gate.gate_condition: User confirms CF Access application creation

epistemic_flags: CF Access pricing for this use case unverified in current account — free tier assumed based on your documentation reference
GitHub OAuth as CF Access IdP redirect flow may interact with existing CF tunnel configuration — requires verification during setup
